parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the details—this sounds highly disruptive, and I’m sorry for the impact on your reporting. We’ve flagged this for urgent human review on our Engineering team given the post–v2.8 timing and the repeated Salesforce auth token refresh errors.

To help us act as fast as possible for your renewal call tomorrow, could you share the following (even partial is fine)?
1) The exact auth token refresh error message(s) or error code(s) from the logs (copy/paste a few lines).
2) Approximate timestamps when failures began after the v2.8 upgrade, and whether it started immediately or at a specific time.
3) Whether the failing sync is specifically “Salesforce production sync” (and not sandbox/other environments).
4) Which tenants/customers are affected (you mentioned ~40 enterprise customers)—are these the same set consistently?
5) Any correlation IDs/job IDs from the failing sync runs (or the sync job/run ID) and how many sync attempts are failing.

Once we have that, we’ll confirm the affected sync job(s) and advise on the next steps we can take immediately. If you can’t locate everything right now, the most helpful would be the exact error text/code(s) plus a timestamp range tied to the upgrade window.
